subject: MAP: Acme migration — signoff cadence & start date
messages:
From: Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@acme.io>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@acme.io
Date: Mon, 24 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -07:00
Subject: MAP and final signoff cadence for migration

Rishi,

Thanks again for the walkthrough this morning. Attached is our latest version of the MAP (Acme-MAP-v4.pdf) and an updated SOW. High level: we are targeting a production start on 2026-09-15 (preferred), with a staging window starting 2026-09-01.

What we need from Redwood to close on our side:
- Final go/no-go signoff deadline (we typically allow a 5 business day window)
- Standard signature cadence (DocuSign/PO timing)
- Confirmation of any SLA exceptions (data residency) needed to pass our legal review

Can your team confirm the earliest date you can commit to signoff? Our procurement team wants the DocuSign window scheduled so we can align internal approvals. Im also copying procurement to keep the timeline visible.

Attachments: Acme-MAP-v4.pdf (MAP), SOW-Acme-v2.docx

Cheers,
Jordan
Jordan Lee
Sr. Product Operations | Acme Corp

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@acme.io>
Cc: monica.patel@redwood.ai, laura.bennett@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 24 Aug 2026 11:02:15 -07:00
Subject: Re: MAP and final signoff cadence for migration

Jordan —

Appreciate the MAP and the clear ask. Quick read-through notes below and proposed cadence:

1) Internal signoff window: Redwood can provide a formal go/no-go decision within a 7-business-day window after we receive your final PO and any legal redlines. If procurement can issue PO by 2026-08-28, our target for formal signoff is 2026-09-08.

2) Signature flow: we recommend DocuSign for the SOW + Order Form. We can prepare the envelope once legal confirms redlines. Typical turnaround we see is 3-5 business days for your side.

3) SLA/data residency: please highlight any clause youre expecting an exception for. Our legal/infra team will evaluate and we can escalate to Markus if an exception is required.

4) Start date: we can support the requested 2026-09-15 start if signoff completes by 2026-09-08. If signoff slips beyond 2026-09-10 wed need to push to the next available slot (late-September).

Next steps:
- Jordan/procurement: share final PO and any redline comments by 2026-08-28 (if you want 9/15 start).
- Monica: can you confirm finance/contract intake timeline?
- Laura: please weigh in on SLA exceptions and signoff cadence.

Rishi
Rishi Malhotra
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Rishi / Laura,

Looping through internal constraints so were aligned on expectations for the customer:

- Finance/PO: We need a copy of the PO and the billing contact to create the invoice. If procurement can issue PO by 08/28 we can route for finance approval quickly; otherwise invoice timing slips.
- Legal: Any SLA/data residency exception will trigger an additional review (up to 5 business days). Laura, please confirm whether the changes in the attached SOW (SOW-Acme-v2.docx) are standard or require escalation.
- Signature cadence: Recommend a DocuSign envelope window of Aug 30  Sep 03. That gives procurement a full-week to review after PO and lets us schedule the onboarding kickoff for 09/15. If procurement needs earlier signatures we can do an expedited review but will need to escalate to Markus to approve an SLA carve-out.

Also attaching a short checklist for close (attachment: signature-instructions.pdf) with fields procurement must fill out when sending the PO (billing contact, tax ID, remit instructions).

Monica

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@acme.io>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Cc: monica.patel@redwood.ai, markus.klein@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 26 Aug 2026 15:10:00 -07:00
Subject: Final signoff conditions and signature window (Acme migration)

Jordan —

Thanks for the MAP and the SOW. After internal review we can provide a conditional go/no-go signoff under the following conditions:

1) Purchase Order (PO) is received and valid by 2026-08-28 (billing contact + remit info complete).
2) Any legal redlines are returned by 2026-08-28; minor redlines we accept as edits, material SLA exceptions require written approval from Markus.
3) DocuSign envelope scheduled for Aug 30  Sep 03 (our proposed window).

If the above items are satisfied we will sign the SOW in that signature window and confirm the onboarding kickoff for 2026-09-15. If items (1) or (2) slip beyond 2026-08-30 we will need to move the start date to the earliest available slot in late September; I will notify you if we need to shift the timeline.

Ive attached the signature instructions and a short checklist (signature-instructions.pdf). Jordan, please confirm you can get procurement to submit the PO and redlines by Friday. Happy to hop on a 30-minute call if you want to walk procurement through the DocuSign steps.

Best,
Laura Bennett
Head of Legal Operations | Redwood Inference

Attachments: signature-instructions.pdf
